general_information.Description: Main objective: The course provides students the theory of the profession as a real front office employee by handling the diverse tasks in each position in the front-office department. Description: The course provides the theory of daily tasks of each position cross front office department such as receptionist, phone operator, cashier, night auditor…etc…With various day to day situation to deal and to handle, learner will be familiar with front office operations enhancing competitive advantage on the hotel job market. -Teaching method: lecture, discussion, project based learning, group work
general_information.StudentTasks: - Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots in order to be accepted to the final examination. - Student is responsible to do all exercises, assignments and labs given by instructor in class or at home and submit on time - Use laptop in class only for learning purpose - Promptly access to the FU CMS at http://flm.fpt.edu.vn for up-to-date course information

learning_outcomes.CLO Details: Demonstrate highly cooperation and discipline the team, instructor and school regulation
Understand and know how to use hotel management system
Explain the reservation concept & procedure and master receptionist profession
Describe and master bell and concierge profession
Comprend and master the phone operator functions
Analyze and solve situations skillfully in reservation and guest relation service.
Explain and perform front office cashier function.
Explain and execute the night audit function

assessments.Knowledge and Skill: - To create a disciplined environment and maintain a professional interface as a internationl hotelier standard, It is manatory for student to follow two indispensible aspects in service industry as a grading criteria, which are attitude and professional grooming.
assessments.Grading Guide: Students must comply perfectly with school & class regulation such as grooming, uniform, personal hygiene and attitude coming to demo front office with details the following: 1. Attitude - Work seriously and attentively - Respect and protect school asset. - Strongly communication and teamworking. - Be on time with professional grooming 2. Dress & Grooming Code For Boys: - School uniform or personal clothes including Black Trousers, White Shirt Full Sleeves, Tie or Vest (Entering class with Jeans & T shirts is not allowed) -The sleeves of a full sleeve shirt should never be rolled up. - Formal shoes (black) and black socks. - No Ear rings, bangles except for religious purpose are allowed in the class. - Any kind of hair dye and spike hair style is strictly prohibited. - In winter black coat and black pullover. - Wearing of Name tag is mandatory for all students during class For Girls: - School Uniform or personal clothes such as Black Trousers, White Shirt Full Sleeves, Vest or Ao dai (Entering class with Jeans & T shirts is not allowed) - The sleeves of shirt should never be rolled up. - Formal black shoes with ankle high socks. - No visible painting including mehendi and tattoos. - Only one ear ring/top. - In winter black coat and black cardigan without collar are allowed. - Hair should be tied in Bun shape during class.
assessments.Note: Students must attend more than 80% of contact slots Attendance check at any time during course

assessments.CLO: CLO2, CLO3, CLO4, CLO5, C, LO6, CLO7, CLO8
